provenance: Real Kestrix output on a synthetic input generated by scripts/build_landing_samples.py.

findings.title: Extension does not match the content
findings.explanation: The name ends in .pdf, but the content was identified as Windows program (PE executable). Renaming programs to look like documents or images is a common malware trick.

findings.title: Program may be packed or contain encrypted code
findings.explanation: 48 KiB (100%) of this program looks random. Packers and encrypted payloads look like this, and malware uses them to hide its code from scanners; installers and programs with compressed resources can look the same. Treat it with extra care, and use a packer detector or a sandbox if you need certainty.

findings.title: File is a program
findings.explanation: The content was identified as Windows program (PE executable). A program can do anything your user account can, so run it only if you trust where it came from.
